_comment: SOURCE-INGEST ROLE — the only role that may ADD to the archive.
Ingest is rare and deliberate: a new source obligation appears, a human runs
`source-archive.py ingest`, and the artifact is written once with a retention
stamp. This role can do exactly that and read back what it wrote (verification
after upload is part of ingest — PutObject returning 200 proves nothing).
It can EXTEND a retention period (s3:PutObjectRetention) because retention is
monotonic and extending is safe. It CANNOT shorten one under GOVERNANCE,
because shortening requires s3:BypassGovernanceRetention, which is
explicitly denied below and is held only by a human administrator. Under
COMPLIANCE mode no principal can shorten one at all.
DELIBERATELY ABSENT, and asserted absent by tests/test_source_archive.py:
iam:*, kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion, and every action outside this one bucket.

_why: An ingest that forgot the Object Lock headers would write an artifact with
no retention at all — a silent hole in the archive that looks exactly like
a good one. The condition makes the bucket refuse it rather than making the
tool responsible for never making the mistake.
Written as a Deny on the absence of the header, because a Condition on an
Allow is satisfied by any OTHER Allow the principal might hold.
